abandon_criterion.note: drop a ladder when two fresh-seed rungs agree below the filed bound or the per-solve time cap binds

bar.note: every entry whose distance is currently a witnessed upper bound

direction.expected_value: A board whose starred entries carry exact distances rather than upper bounds, removing inflated-bound risk from the frontier.
direction.feasibility: certification_queue.py, sat_certify.py and tropidist already exist and certify_sweep runs weekly; a campaign only needs a larger budget and a recorded ledger.
direction.hypothesis: Board-wide SAT/tropidist certification can convert the board's witnessed upper bounds into proven exact distances, starting from the certification queue's head.

novelty.against: committed codes/ entries and their recorded witnesses
novelty.claim: proven lower bounds for entries currently carrying only upper bounds

direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: That the queue's head is already tight at the available time limits, so effort should move to construction rather than certification.

campaign.name: Board-wide lower-bound (exact distance) campaign
campaign.notes: Targets every entry in research/certs/todo.json (the certification queue). Uses sat_certify (CSS) and tropidist (stabilizer). Refuted/loosened bounds are filed as distance revisions, not new submissions. No GPU: SAT and tropidist are exact CPU work.
